content.short: Snuggle offers automated liquidity management for Bitcoin, ETH and stablecoin deposits.
content.description: Snuggle manages liquidity positions automatically for depositors holding Bitcoin, ETH and stablecoins on Robinhood Chain, presenting the result as passive income rather than a position requiring attention. Products framed this way are worth reading carefully on how the yield is produced, since automated LP returns depend heavily on the volatility of the pair.
